QuestInfo.name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls
QuestInfo.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
QuestInfo.1: #p305# asked for my help one last time, this time to hunt #r200 #o38#s#k and collect #b200 #t4000033#s#k. Does she really need THIS many? Is it working?
QuestInfo.2: I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in a forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b200 #t4000033#s#k for #p305#. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I collected so many dolls for her, but it seemed like the #o38#s aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... I wonder what was going on. However, it seemed that the fairies might not have as much animosity toward humans now... That's a good thing, at least.

0.0: Traveler, you've returned... again. I'm sorry to keep asking you, but I need you to bring me more #t4000033#s. This is the last time, I promise. Can you bring me #b200 #t4000033#s#k?

yes.0: Thank you so much. The #o38#s are often seen in the Dark Tree Forest near #m10002000#. Please take down #r200 #o38#s#k and bring me #b200 #t4000033#s#k.

no.0: I see... I thought I could count on you for this, but if you are busy, then I understand. Please come back if you ever have a change of heart.

1.0: This is... Wow! You've brought me #b200 #t4000033#s#k! That means you've thinned out the #o38#s. But it's too early to be relieved, because this doll is capable of continuously making new puppets.
1.1: Oh yeah, take this as a token of my appreciation. The fairies will spread word of your good deed. I personally think you deserve to be called a hero, and not just because you saved me from a pickle!

yes.0: I have increased your fame a little. I've also given you a hat made with fairy magic. Please put it to good use. Thank you so much for your help.
yes.1: Maybe fairies are unfairly prejudiced against humans. I'm confident that you'll protect this forest for all of us. Well then, so long...

mob.0: Don't forget to defeat the #r#o38#s#k as well.

item.0: So, you weren't able to collect #b200 #t4000033#s#k yet. The #t4000033# is making more Puppets of itself as we speak. You need to hurry up and bring me the dolls.
